tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i mdos bskang dngos grub chu rgyun bzhugs so// swasti/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rab dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang gso dngos grub rol mtsho zhes gtor bskang cung zad rgyas pa dang mdos bskang bsdus pa'i rnam gzhag lhan cig tu gsungs pa de nyid las/ mdos bskang nyid zur du phyung ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba mdos dang rjes 'brel bskang ba'i bsham ni sa lo'i gsung rab de nyed las rtogs par bya zhing / mdos kyi sger bsham ni/ ji ltar 'os pa'i bar shing ram/ 'jim pa la ri rab bang rim bzhi pa/ mthar gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ lcags ri dang bcas pa mtshon gyis kha dog bsgyur ba la/ rin po che sna lnga brdar ba/ khog snying gser g.yu gang rung bcug pa'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ gur zhal nam mkha' dang bcas pa/ bang rim gnyis pa la nam mkha' bzhi/ rgyang bu bzhi/ bar bar du bya nag dgu/ bang rim gsum pa la/ ra g.yag lug khyi mi nag bud med dre'u zhon pa rnams dgu dgu/ mda' 'phang khra bo dgu skor/ bang rim bzhi pa la nam mkha' brgyad dang / rgyang bu brgyad/ pho gdong mo gdong khram shing dgu dgu/ zhal bu dgu/ chang bu dgu/ mtheb skyu dgu rnams bkod/ mdos kyi mdun du glud gzugs dbang po tshang zhing dod pa gos rgyan sogs bskang ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar dang / bshos bu dmar po dgu/ mchod pa khrag gi ar+ghaṃ nyer lnga rnams bshams/ mdos kyi dbus su mda' bya rgod ma dar snas brgyan pa/ mdor na dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par 'du bya ba ni sbyor ba'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la sa lo'i gsung rabs der sa bcad bzhi gsung pa las/ bzhi pa mdos kyi bskang ba la gsum/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'bul ba/ glud bsngo ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa'i mdos la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/

zhes brjod cing lag pa gnyis thal mo khog stong sbyar/ sor mo rnams rtse sprad pa/ chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya bcas te/ mdos kyi 'bag pa dang mi gtsang ba ma dag par snang ba thams cad stong par gyur/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing / lag pa gnyis mnyam pa'i thal mo la sor mo dbus ma gsum gyi tshegs bar ma bcags pa/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya ces te/ mdos rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ri rab gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa/ lcogs brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtha' bskor du gling bzhi gling phran brgyad lcags ri dang bcas pa'i steng du sku mtshon byed zhal gyi nam mkha' nag po'i mthar rin po che sna lnga'i gzha' ris kyis bskor ba/ gzhan yang mtha' bskor du rin po che dang gos dar las byas pa'i nam mkha' rgyang bu/ bya nag rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag mi nag bud med nag mo dre'u zhon pa/ sha khrag bdud rtsi lnga'i zhal zas/ gser gyi snod rtsi bcud kyis gang ba/ dbus su thugs kyi rten rdo rje rtse lnga pa khor yug tu pho gdong skyes pa stag chas kyis brgyan pa bro 'khrabs pa/ mo gdong bud med mdzes ma dar zab kyis brgyan pa glu len pa/ stag pa'i khram shing dgra bgegs zil gyis gnon pa ngar mi lus dang dbang po rdzogs shing gos dang rgyan nor sna tshogs kyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces brjod la lag pa gnyis thal mo kha sbyar ba kha phye la/ mthe bong bsnol ba bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya bcas nas/ mdos 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga tshang ba thams cad kyang / mgron so so'i yid bzhin du thob pa la bgegs dang nyer 'tshe med par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twad oṃ aḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod lag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag byas la/

mdos 'gros so so'i gang la gang 'dod pa'i dngos po yid bzhin du 'byung bar gyur cig oṃ dz+nyā na a ba lo ki te/ na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa/ rasmi bha wa ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hrī da dz+wa la ya swāhā/ mgron rnams drag zhan che chung med pa so so'i yid tshim zhing rang dbang du longs spyod par gyur/ zhes brjod cing lag g.yon khu tshur bcang ba pang du bzhag lag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo bsgreng pa'i sdigs mdzub bstan pa ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya byas te/ na maḥs man+ta bhud+dha nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañtsa ti ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdos kyi mchod pa bskal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du zad pa med cing mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig lag pa gnyis rdo rje nang bsdams spyi bo'i thad kar bskor ba/ dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bya ste/ sngags re re'ang lan gsum gsum brjod cing / sngags re re la phyag rgya 'cha' theb re'i mthar se gol re re gtog de dag ni mdos byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa mdos dbul ba ni/ bh+yoḥ drag po'i gzhal yas mtshan nyid ldan pa 'dir/ /dam rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar bcas pa/ /phyi nang mchod gtor 'dod yon sna tshogs bshams/ /yid 'phrog bkod legs mdos kyi mchod pa ni/ /'bru sna rin chen lnga las legs grub pa'i/ /ri rab bang rim bzhi ldan lcog gi steng / /mthing nag 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad gur gyi dbus/ /thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /sku yi mtshon byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi/ /zhal gyi nam mkha' phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas dang / /rin chen pad+ma sna tshogs mkha' 'gro rnams/ /mnyes byed nam mkha' bzhi dang rgyang bu bzhi/ /'jig rten las kyi mkha' 'gro sde brgyad la/ /khor yug nam mkha' mdzes pa brgyad kyis bskor/ /rab tu bkra ba'i rgyang bu'i phreng ba can/ /mdung la dar btags bya nag rta mchog dang /

/g.yag rog lug nag khyi nag mi nag tshogs/ /pho glud mda' khra mo glud 'phang khra dang / /dgra bgegs zil gnon stag pa'i khram shing dang / /pho gdong dpa' bo stag chas kyis brgyan pa/ /mo gdong bud med mdzes ma glu len cing / /re re'ang srin po'i grangs ldan phyogs kun khyab/ /gzhan yang rin chen sman sna dar tshon dang / /stag gzig go khrab mtshon cha'i tshogs rnams kun/ /thugs kyi rten mchog nal bu'i sha khrag dang / /ljon shing sna tshogs khyim bya nag mo dang / /bong bu gwa dmar dre'u nag mo sogs/ /thun mong ma yin thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul lha mi'i longs spyod kyis/ /ma gcig lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /yum chen e ka dza ṭa'i༞ /gshin rje yum chen bdud kyi sring mo mchog /dpal ldan nam gru chen mo'i༞ /ba glang kriṣ+ṇa chu srin gdong can ma/ /seng ge'i gdong can lcags rkang srog gzer sogs/ /nad rims bdag mo 'bum sde'i thugs dam bskang / /so gnyis yul dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas/ /skyong mdzad ma mo mkha' 'gro'i༞ /dur khrod brgyad gnas sha za mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'dir byon dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs kun rgyas pa dang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen bsam pa'i don/ /yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /gsum pa glud bsngo ba ni/ bh+yoḥri rab gling bzhi lus kyi glud du bzhes/ /ngag gi glud du nam mkha' sna tshogs 'bul/ /rgyang bu'i phreng ba yid kyi glud du bzhes/ /'bru sna lnga ni phung po lnga yi glud/ /rin chen sna lnga 'byung ba lnga yi glud/ /dar tshon sna tshogs rnam shes brgyad kyi glud/ /sha khrag sna tshogs khams dang skye mched glud/ /mda' 'phang khra bo pho dang mo yi glud/ /zang zing glud du srog chags sna tshogs 'bul/ /srog glud dam par ri rab mdos chog dang /

/rin chen 'bru sna lnga las grub pa yi/ /dbang po yongs rdzogs ngar mi lung thang mig /'gron bu'i so dang mu tig klad pa can/ /zer mo'i skra dang zho sha'i snying ldan pa/ /zangs ma'i sna dang smin ma g.yas g.yon g.yu/ /lag g.yas gser la g.yon pa dngul gyis byas/ /rkang pa g.yas g.yon lcags zangs gos dang nor/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i srog glud kyis/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas rab dges nas/ /sngags 'chang rig 'dzin bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /bsam don sgrubs la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs kun/ /myur du bsad cing bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig /gzhan gyi rigs sngags rbod gtong byad ka dang / /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu'i gnod pa bzlog /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang dal yams kun/ /dgra bo'i steng du phob la tshar gcod cig /'khor du gnas pa'i nad bdag thams cad kyis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i yul 'khor brlag par mdzod/ /ma mo'i khrag zor gshin rje'i 'khor lo dang / /phur pa'i dbal kha bon po'i btso dmar 'phen/ /klu bdud mnan gtad rgyal po'i thog rdzis dang / /dmu btsan gza' dang rgyu skar gnod pa bzlog /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag thun mong gi /phrin las myur 'grub mthar thug bla med kyi/ /byang chub thob nas khams gsum kun sgrol zhing / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog/ //gsum pa rjes 'phrin las bskul zhing smon lam bkra shis kyi mtha' brten par bya ba la gsum/ bshad cing las la bskul ba/ 'phral gtor gtang 'dod don bsgo ba/ lhag chad kha bskang zhing bzod gsol shis par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gur gyi mgon po'i bstod pa gsar rnying gang rung dang / bye brag 'di nyid kyi bstod pa til mar ma'am/ phyag na rdo rjes nam gru'i rigs la/ bstod pa la gzhi byas kho bos brtsam pa de'am/ drag por byed na/ mi pham ma bskul dang bcas pa byed/ gzhan yang dpal mgon sogs la gang dgos kyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya ste/

bzlog pa bdag chen blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i lha mo'i skang bzlog bzhin bya'o/ /rjes kyi sa bcad gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni sa lo'i gsung rabs bzhin no// //zhes dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams ma'i mdos bskang zur du byung ba 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i mdos bskang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
